Texts.LongWelcomeMessage: Welcome to the application. This is a startup project based on the ABP framework. For more information visit
Texts.Dashboard:Placeholder: Your real dashboard is on the way. For now, here's what's available.
Texts.Landing:Headline: The loyalty app your customers already have.
Texts.Landing:Lead: Eksabli is one wallet across every business a customer joins — so when you launch your program, you're not asking for a new download. You're asking for a tap.
Texts.Landing:Step1Body: Scan a QR at checkout, or find your business inside the app they already have installed.
Texts.Landing:Step2Body: Set your point rules, tiers, and campaigns once — they run automatically after that.
Texts.Landing:Step3Title: They come back for the reward
Texts.Landing:Step3Body: Redeem with a QR code or a PIN at checkout — no punch-cards, no spreadsheets.
Texts.Landing:FeaturesHeading: Built for a real counter, not a demo
Texts.Landing:Feature1Body: Every business gets its own point balance. What a customer earns at your café never dilutes what they've earned anywhere else.
Texts.Landing:Feature2Body: Double-points weekends, birthday bonuses, win-back offers for customers going quiet — built in, not bolted on.
Texts.Landing:Feature3Body: Award points by QR or a phone-number lookup — built for a real line at checkout, not a demo.
Texts.Landing:Feature4Body: Full right-to-left support out of the box — not a translation afterthought.
Texts.Landing:LedgerFact2: 2 ways to redeem — QR or PIN
Texts.Landing:PricingSub: Illustrative tiers — talk to us for a plan sized to your business.
Texts.Landing:CtaHeading: Ready to meet customers where they already are?
